name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx hosting for three static virtual hosts with HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects, self-signed TLS certificates, security headers, compression, rate limiting, Fail2ban, UFW, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including service enablement, Redis logging, password authentication, and post-configuration handling of replication directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python, PostgreSQL, development dependencies, and Git; deploys the FastAPI tutorial application in a virtual environment, provisions its database, configures environment settings, and runs it through systemd on port 8000.
